bubbles.text: Hey, this is AVA with Ridgeline Plumbing — sorry we missed you by one ring. What's going on?
Kitchen sink won't stop dripping and now there's water under the cabinet
Got it — a leak under the sink. Is the water still running, or did you shut it off?
Shut it off at the valve
Nice work — that stops the damage. I can get a tech out. First opening is tomorrow 8:00 AM, or same-day tonight at the emergency rate. Which do you want?
Perfect. Can I put this under your name and this number?
Dana — and yeah, this number's good
Booked, Dana — tomorrow 8:00 AM, leak under the kitchen sink. Confirmation text incoming 👇
✅ Ridgeline Plumbing — Tue 8:00 AM. Reply C to confirm, R to reschedule.
Confirmed. We'll text again when the tech is 30 minutes out. Thanks, Dana!
